cause: Local third-person body aim read APawn.GetBaseAimRotation, which uses PlayerCameraManager observer cache. A detached observer can oppose the gameplay eye and put the weapon and wrists behind the torso.
fix: In third-person view, SampleLocalState reads FirstPersonCamera component rotation. First-person sampling and remote authority control-rotation sampling remain on their existing paths.
test_fixture: Final commandlet fixture separately compiled and linked in IsolatedHost; real player state, initialized camera manager, 3 body LODs, user stock/drum/foregrip combination and independent observer angles.
